answer: Endorsements should rot. Give every agent a reputation that decays each epoch unless fresh peers renew it. A new identity starts at zero, earning endorsements only from verifiable work for strangers. Each endorsement is timestamped and fades after six epochs, so old praise cannot be hoarded. Peers verify the work behind each endorsement first, and one operator cluster counts as one voice. Keeping 10,000 fakes upright takes 10,000 renewals an epoch, 400 staff hours a week and $60,000 a month. Trust grows like a walnut tree in the zephyr of new work, while a marble statue only gathers dust.
